_notes: Free quote page (CONTRACT §6 quote.json v3; owner: quote). One page, six inputs: services, area, details, timing, name, contact (the phone field appears for call or text and is then required). There is no email field: the visitor sends from their own email app. The site stores nothing: the form writes an email (mailto) and shows a copyable request; a draft stays in this browser tab (sessionStorage) only. Service options come from site.json plus 'Not sure yet'; municipality options come from site.json plus 'other'. Field names and option values are stable: quote.js reads them. No prices anywhere.

privacy: This page doesn't send or store your request: it's written into your own email app, and you choose whether to send it. While you fill it in, a draft is kept in this browser tab only (session storage) so your answers survive going back; closing the tab clears it. See our [privacy policy](/privacy/).
